label_en: Alhamdulillah — All praise is due to Allah
Allahu Akbar — Allah is the Greatest

label_ms: Maha Suci Allah dan dengan segala pujian-Nya
label_en: Glory be to Allah and all praise is His

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
label_ms: Dua kalimah yang ringan di lidah, berat di timbangan
label_en: Two phrases light on the tongue, heavy on the scale

label_ms: Aku memohon keampunan Allah Yang Maha Agung
label_en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah, the Most Great

arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
label_ms: Tiada tuhan melainkan Allah, Esa tiada sekutu bagi-Nya; milik-Nya kerajaan dan segala pujian, dan Dia Maha Berkuasa atas segala sesuatu
label_en: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and all praise, and He is able to do all things

arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
label_ms: Tiada daya dan kekuatan melainkan dengan Allah
label_en: There is no power nor strength except with Allah

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
label_ms: Selawat ke atas Nabi Muhammad SAW dan keluarga baginda
label_en: Salutations upon Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and his family
Last two verses of Al-Baqarah (before sleep)
